audio.text: Is it just me, or is the Wi-Fi really slow today?

options: The password is on the wall.
I usually study in my room.
It's not just you. Mine keeps disconnecting.

why.en: Idiomatic question → a shared experience. C takes it literally.
why.tr: Deyimsel soru → paylaşılan deneyim. C sözcüğü sözcüğüne yanıt.
why.es: Pregunta idiomática → una experiencia compartida. C la toma de forma literal.
